Bodies found near roadsides in Punjab and Himachal Pradesh

Two bodies were discovered near roadsides in separate incidents in northern India. In Faridkot, Punjab, a young man's body was found lying on a bench under a tree by the roadside, with no signs of movement. In Kangra, Himachal Pradesh, an unidentified person's body was found near a stream. Police have initiated investigations into both cases.
